description.value: Andreas Restaurant is a long-established Greek and Italian family restaurant in Langley, operated since 1984 by father-and-son duo Andreas and Dimitrios. The scratch kitchen turns out over 130 menu items daily—from souvlaki and lamb dishes to house-made pizzas and 28-day-aged AAA steaks—with a firm commitment to never using pre-packaged or vacuum-sealed prepared food. Touring cyclists will find a warm, family-focused atmosphere with dine-in, takeout, and delivery all available, and a banquet room for larger groups.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at andreasrestaurant.ca loaded successfully and corroborates the OSM address (20227 56 Ave, Langley, BC), confirms active operation with online ordering and reservations, and provides a phone number absent from OSM. Takeout is explicitly confirmed by the homepage ('Dine in, take out, or order online today') and vegetarian options are directly evidenced by a dedicated Vegetarian pizza on the pizza menu. No mention of bike parking, Wi-Fi, water refill, or other cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; (604) 533-0111 sourced from website only.
Website lists a second Andreas Restaurant location in North Vancouver (153 16th St W, (604) 985-0414); this OSM record covers the Langley location only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating full-service restaurant with a live website, confirmed address, and multiple service options; no grounds for exclusion.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Pizza menu includes a dedicated Vegetarian pizza (mushrooms, green peppers, onions, tomatoes, pineapple, olives, cheese & tomato sauce); Greek salads and Mediterranean-style dishes also available
